name: Close Ranks
description:
While you and at least one ally are adjacent to one another, you and all contiguous, adjacent allies gain +1 Defense.

Once per round, as a free action, you may spend 1 MP to give an adjacent ally +1d on a single melee attack roll.

Describe how you form up.

improvements.name: Shield Wall
improvements.description: If you and your adjacent allies are all wielding shields, each of you automatically wins any engagements you enter as defenders.

improvements.name: Hold The Line
improvements.description: When you or any of your adjacent allies are attacked, all of you may contribute engagement dice and successes to the engagement.
